_comment: Single source of truth for video output dimensions, frame rate, and per-profile defaults. Read by remotion-templates/src/design/theme.ts (TypeScript) AND tools/video_config.py (Python). Both surfaces must stay in sync — that's exactly what this file prevents drifting. To change channel-wide render dimensions: edit here, regenerate test baselines, run full visual regression.

episode._comment: Standard 16:9 episode render — what every Composition with no override emits.

short._comment: Vertical 9:16 short for YouTube Shorts / Reels / TikTok.

thumbnail._comment: Static 16:9 thumbnail at half-render resolution for fast iteration. Matches YouTube's recommended source dimensions.

social._comment: Per-platform export crops. fps doesn't apply to stills.
